newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Xinhua to include in HSCEI.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Xinhua to include in HSCEI.

text.p: Medicine manufacturer Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co Ltd will be included as a constituent stock of the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index (HSCEI) with effect from Thursday, HSI Services Ltd said on Monday.
With the addition of Shandong Xinhua, which is to be listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange on Tuesday, there will be 23 constituent stocks in the HSCEI, it said.
HSCEI is to track the overall performance of all China enterprises listed in Hong Kong. The index is managed and compiled by HSI Services, a wholly-owned unit of Hang Seng Bank.
